question: Which of the following antitussive can lead to hallucinations
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Dextromethorphan" -> "acts on central nervous system" -> "can cause dissociative effects" -> "possible hallucinations" -> 75%
CHAIN: "Morphine" -> "opioid receptor agonist" -> "primarily causes euphoria and pain relief" -> "hallucinations not commonly reported" -> 20%
CHAIN: "Diphenhydramine" -> "anticholinergic properties" -> "can cross blood-brain barrier" -> "possible confusion and hallucinations in high doses" -> 60%
CHAIN: "Aprepitant" -> "substance P/neurokinin 1 receptor antagonist" -> "used to prevent chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting" -> "hallucinations not a known side effect" -> 10%
analysis: Dextromethorphan, at high doses, acts on NMDA receptors leading to dissociative effects and hallucinations, aligning with its known pharmacological profile and reported side effects in medical literature. This makes it the most likely among the options to cause hallucinations.
